answer: Because the pulse derivation is checked against the canyon nonce, the vault audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 33 aliases produces 33 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 22 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
